name: General Data Protection Regulation
summary: EU data protection; access controls and least privilege over personal data.

name: Network and Information Security Directive 2
summary: EU cyber-resilience mandate raising access governance and accountability requirements.

name: Digital Operational Resilience Act
summary: EU financial-sector operational resilience, including ICT and access risk.

name: Sarbanes-Oxley Act
summary: US controls over financial reporting; segregation of duties and access certification.

name: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act
summary: US healthcare data protection; minimum-necessary access to PHI.

name: Lei Geral de Protecao de Dados
summary: Brazil's data protection law, close analogue to GDPR.
